vorschau.en: Ground space index within a search radius for every grid cell: how dense is the city around each place – and how much does that depend on the radius chosen?

original: Discovering Cities Workshop | Amman – Building coverage Density (GSI Density Grid)
autoren: DeCodingSpaces / Bauhaus-Universität Weimar (Workshopleitung nicht namentlich genannt)
